theorems.name: Submission.upperDensity_ne_zero_outside_hausdorff_null
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), NullMeasurableSet A ν → ν A < ∞ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) {x | x ∉ A ∧ limsup (fun r : ℝ => ν (A ∩ closedBall x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≠ 0} = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
